narr: Showers and thunderstorms repeatedly moved across Northern Alabama and Southern Middle TN. Numerous roads were closed in Lincoln County, with widespread rainfall amounts of 3-6 across much of the area. Portions of NW Madison received 6-8 over a few hours, leading to flash flooding.
ev: Leighton Police Dept reports several streets in downtown Leighton under 4-5 feet of water. Also, County Line Road just south of Hwy 20 has about 5-6 feet of water covering it.
